import Foundation
import ImageIO

for path in CommandLine.arguments.dropFirst() {
    guard let src = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(URL(fileURLWithPath: path) as CFURL, nil) else { print(path, "unreadable"); continue }
    let props = CGImageSourceCopyPropertiesAtIndex(src, 0, nil) as? [CFString: Any] ?? [:]
    let o = props[kCGImagePropertyOrientation] ?? "none"
    let opts = [kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true, kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
                kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: 4096] as CFDictionary
    let th = CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex(src, 0, opts)
    print((path as NSString).lastPathComponent, "orientation property:", o, " shown (transformed):", th.map { "\($0.width)x\($0.height)" } ?? "none")
}
